forbidden_actions: remote Git, merge, deploy, release, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent product facts, brand authority, copy claims, customer data, assets, evidence, or approval
perform an adjacent capability or combine independent review with source repair
treat static inspection, stale capture, or model self-report as current rendered evidence
claim Phase 9 evaluation, Phase 10 approval, or release evidence that has not run
hard_gates: The design direction cannot pass unless each major visual or spatial choice traces to product purpose, audience, content, brand authority, or an explicitly human-owned taste decision.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: Product facts, a brief, design assets, tokens, components, surface context, and references.
responsibility: Translate approved product behavior, audience, brand evidence, surface mode, content needs, and success criteria into an auditable design direction contract.
